user.title: Status board
user.description: A board holds checks for this Home Assistant installation. Entity ids, limits, and sentences stay on this installation.

abort.already_configured: A board with this name already exists

user.title: Add check
user.description: A check watches one or more entities and turns on when the verdict needs attention. All means every condition must pass. Any means one passing condition is enough. Formula uses condition ids with and, or, not, and parentheses. A condition id is true when that test passes.

data_description.object_id: Lowercase id, starting with a letter. Used in formulas. Leave blank to build it from the name. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.category: Free text, such as Water or Security. Used to group counts.
data_description.display_entity: The reading shown on a row while the check is OK. The live value is not copied into this check.
data_description.formula: Condition ids with and, or, not, and parentheses. A condition id is true when that test passes. Example: pressure and leak
data_description.hold: How long a new verdict must last before it is published. Empty publishes immediately. The first reading after a restart is published immediately.
data_description.message_ok: Leave blank for OK. Placeholders such as {value} are kept as text and filled in when a card or notification is rendered.

reconfigure.title: Edit check
reconfigure.description: Id: {object_id}. The id stays the same so dashboards and formulas keep working.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Add every test for this check, then save.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: The condition id is the name used in a formula. Range and state need an entity. Template does not.

data.unavailable_severity: Severity when it is not reporting

condition_detail.title: Condition details
condition_detail.description: Limits are inclusive. Equal to the minimum or maximum is OK. After a breach, the value must pass the limit by the hysteresis before the breach clears.

data_description.expected_state: Matched exactly, for example on, off, home, or a sensor state.
data_description.template: Rendered true means this condition passes. False means it failed. An error counts as not reporting.
data_description.message_low: Optional. Placeholders such as {value}, {min}, {max}, {state}, and {expected} are stored as text, not filled with the live reading.

error.invalid_object_id: Use a lowercase id that starts with a letter and contains only letters, numbers, and underscores
error.keyword_id: and, or, and not are reserved
error.already_configured: That id is already used on this board
error.duplicate_condition: That condition id is already used on this check
error.range_required: Enter a minimum, a maximum, or both
error.too_many_conditions: A check can have at most 30 conditions
error.formula_required: Enter a formula, or choose all or any
error.invalid_formula: Formula could not be parsed. Use condition ids with and, or, not, and parentheses
error.formula_unknown: The formula names a condition that is not on this check: {detail}

user.title: Add group
user.description: A group turns on when any selected check needs attention. Create the checks first. Groups are not counted again in the open-issue total.

data_description.object_id: Lowercase id. Leave blank to build it from the name. It cannot be changed later.
data_description.members: The group follows these checks. It does not read sensors itself.

reconfigure.title: Edit group
reconfigure.description: Id: {object_id}. The id stays the same.

abort.no_checks: Add a check before creating a group
